rationale: ZIN rule (owner, 17 October 2026): all art is new and image-generated; never copy assets from other mods. This overrides the kit's third-party source search, so no external source exists for this reference.

generator.prompt: A single full-body character for a 3D model reference, for a dark painterly fantasy grand-strategy game. Straight front view, the whole figure from head to feet visible and centred with margin on every side, standing on nothing, relaxed A-pose with arms angled about 30 degrees away from the body and legs slightly apart, hands open and empty, fingers separated. He holds no weapon, no shield, no staff and no banner; nothing is attached to the hands. Plain flat uniform light grey (#c8c8c8) background, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, no ground, no scenery, no text, no frame. Clear readable silhouette, no loose cloth streamers, no thin floating parts, armour pieces solid and attached to the body. The figure is an orc warrior: a broad, heavily muscled orc with dark green-grey skin, small tusks and a scarred face, wearing crude blackened iron plates strapped over hide and furs, a spiked iron pauldron on one shoulder, a heavy belt with bone trophies, wrapped forearms and iron-shod boots.
